home.label: Trading · ISO Consultation · Research
home.title: Welcome to Manjushree Biotech
home.subtitle: A Nepal-based biotechnology company supplying laboratory products and guiding labs to ISO accreditation today, while building the research and product-development capability we're growing into.
home.whatWeDoIntro: Trading keeps Nepal's labs supplied. Quality consultation keeps them accredited. Together they're funding and informing the biotech research work we're building toward.

pillars.title: Laboratory & biotech trading
pillars.desc: Sourcing and supplying laboratory equipment, reagents, diagnostic kits, and biosafety consumables to hospitals, diagnostic labs, and research institutions.

pillars.title: ISO & laboratory quality consultation
pillars.desc: End-to-end support for ISO 15189:2022 medical laboratory accreditation, biosafety & biosecurity systems, and laboratory waste management — from gap assessment to audit readiness.

pillars.title: Biotech research & product development
pillars.desc: Applying what we learn from trading and quality systems work toward in-house molecular research and diagnostic product development.

about.label: Our mission
about.title: About Manjushree Biotech
about.intro: Manjushree Biotech is a Nepal-based biotechnology company. We supply laboratory products and guide laboratories to accreditation today, while building toward molecular research and diagnostic product development.
about.beliefIntro: Whatever we're doing — supplying a reagent, writing a Quality Manual, or eventually developing a diagnostic product — the standard is the same: laboratory-grade rigor, applied practically.

values.title: Practical over theoretical
values.desc: Solutions built for how a laboratory actually runs, not just what a standard says on paper.

values.title: Built on real laboratory experience
values.desc: Our approach to trading and consultation is grounded in hands-on laboratory and diagnostics work.

values.title: Growing deliberately
values.desc: Trading and consultation fund and inform the research capability we're building, rather than the other way around.
